remarks: Nice and bright condo in East Norwalk. Walking distance to the waterfront, over the bridge to SONO night life. Updated end unit has newer flooring, updated tiled bath, updated kitchen and stainless steel appliances. Semi-open floor plan allows for living/kitchen, dining flexibility, with a full bath between two nice sized bedrooms, both with large closets. Laundry on site, lower level, shared. Easy access to public transportation. Complex is well cared for. Parking for two cars only. Landlord requires credit worthiness and references. Please note that this unit is on the third floor. Very friendly stairs, great sunlight being a top level unit.
